topic: John Darley & Bibb Latane (1968) NYU Intercom Seizure Bystander Effect (85% Solo vs 31% Group Help), Anterior Cingulate Conflict & Diffusion of Responsibility, Columbia Smoke Room Pluralistic Ignorance, and Real-World Direct-Naming Rescue (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Archival debunking of the passive 38-witness Kitty Genovese myth combined with 2020 tri-city CCTV evidence showing 90% bystander intervention in clear street emergencies and single-helper pointing restoring solo rescue speed.
